indications.name: Complicated Urinary Tract Infections, including pyelonephritis
indications.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-11-21: Confirmed by the ORIG-1 approval letter; the original label (ORIG-1) lists it.

evidence.quote: This NDA provides for the use of Zaynich (cefepime and zidebactam) for injection for the treatment of adult patients with complicated urinary tract infections (cUTI) including pyelonephritis caused by designated susceptible microorganisms.

pivotal.indication: Complicated Urinary Tract Infections, including pyelonephritis
pivotal.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-10-30: Confirmed by label section 14 and the registry record.

evidence.quote: A total of 530 adults with cUTI, including pyelonephritis, were randomized in a 2:1 ratio in a multinational, double-blind, noninferiority trial (Trial 1, NCT04979806)
